cases.released-baseline: Observe meaningful released state and settle original writers before the sanctioned Podway upgrade; retain all consumer preimages.
cases.installed-discovery: Load the actual installed epic-squad and Handler skills in fresh native contexts; verify exact candidate and official Podway generation-2 identities.
cases.native-multitask: Execute at least two dependent Tasks using native Squad. Observe both plan scopes, independent first Task panels and EE contributions, sole Writer settlement, exact scoped grants/commits and fresh Task teams with continuous EE.
cases.correction-seams: Exercise local editorial and independently established bounded expectation repair, then a real contract/security correction. Preserve required, optional, invalid and genuinely deferred findings; use actual affected depth/owners and Task reopen at the Task/Epic seam.
cases.negative-evidence: Use a valid fixture with a misleading green test, missing due check, unreadable/truncated report and stale candidate. Observe truthful native negative evidence, rejected achievement and required recovery without erasing original negatives.
cases.operation-recovery: Recover interrupted/partial actual role output through the same public handle; retain results/configuration before supported replacement. Resolve an actionable circular dependency and an explained overrun through current owners without time-based cancellation or duplicate dispatch.
cases.candidate-finalization-recovery: Change the candidate and observe invalidated applicability; exercise an actual authorized hook change and a successful commit interrupted before native finalization. Resume the same operation, retain consumed grant and actual post-hook identity, and prove no duplicate commit/effect.
cases.integration-closeout: Obtain continuous EE plus two fresh nonauthoring TO first integration views and Coordinator product review. Resolve disagreement with original owners, perform a scoped correction commit inside the same Validation session with not-achieved/pending whole-Epic, re-record current integration, and keep actual user closeout acceptance distinct.
cases.handler-continuity: Exercise the retained installed Handler through later checkpoints and at least a subsequent Task plus real same-session recovery. Observe one logical continuous Epic Evaluator, Task Operator labels, no added mandatory TE/support, and original machine/report identities.
cases.consumer-restoration: Settle all run-owned handles and restore exact original CLI, upstream paired skill, plugin registration/configuration/rules and consumer bytes before native collection/cleanup.
cases.mixed-delivery: Execute named installed mixed configurations: external Task Operators with native Evaluators, external Evaluators with native Task Operators, and native Epic Evaluator with an explicit same-CLI external Task Evaluator. Preserve distinct direct EE/TE, original requested profiles, actual route/configuration observations, both plan scopes, first panels, sole Writer and exact Task commits. Report unavailable CLIs and unconfirmed controls separately.
cases.mixed-correction-commit: Use the configured mixed roles for an eligible local correction and a contract correction requiring affected EE judgment. Preserve original assessments, assignment-bound routes/settings, verified deltas and deferred work through an exact Coordinator-owned member/correction commit. Exercise explicit no-additional-review without a fake waiver; keep selected technical reviews separate and final actual user acceptance distinct.

limits: Only actual observed cases may pass.
A capability gap remains unverified; no cross-harness inference.
Actual Master functional verification is separate from native manual scenario results.

original_scenarios.required_observation: Both plan scopes precede implementation; required first assessments, applicable closures/checks and Coordinator acceptance precede a verified Task commit. No Task waits for future Task functionality.

original_scenarios.scenario: Plan defect or material design change
original_scenarios.required_observation: Refresh affected plan scopes before implementation; a material change cannot use local closure, while editorial or bounded clarification does not restart all plan reviews. Both scoped obligations cover the assigned plan.
Every plan receives detailed Task review and an Epic review of direction, verified prior-output use and downstream deliverable design, including plans with no material cross-Task change.

Actual concise assessments and source references reach the Coordinator; the Epic role retains consequential continuity decisions and the Task role retains detail. Concrete concerns allow targeted source inspection; final product review remains substantive.

State-first observation avoids repeated console reads; healthy quiet work is not restarted merely for silence, and repetitive output alone is not progress. Compare read count/volume with detection delay, missed incidents and false recovery.

Requests needing Coordinator action reach it without an in-turn circular wait; one pending participant does not hide a peer's blocked or completed state. Supported safe native interactions remain usable.

An overrun, hung tool or partially detected UI triggers enough inspection to choose continued observation, supported recovery or a reported gap without duplicate dispatch or an endless unexplained wait.
No terminal status prompt queues unintended work; complete reports match the current assignment and revision even after stalled submission or an older visible pass.
Pending handles, requests, candidate and next owners survive recovery through existing runtime records without a new state store or transcript import.

Each new Task starts distinct Task Operator and Task Evaluator instances with fresh conversations where supported, concise source-based handoffs and disclosed inheritance limits; same-Task roles remain recoverable through commit verification while the Epic Evaluator retains continuity.
A plan or result adds an unsupported feature, abstraction or restriction; required behavior working does not prevent rework of the unjustified addition.
An Evaluator or Coordinator proposes optional hardening, an unsupported prerequisite or disproportionate tests; the team excludes it from mandatory work despite reviewer agreement.

A required outcome needs an internal mechanism or defect correction omitted from the design detail; a concrete necessity basis allows it without demanding literal specification of every implementation choice.
Required checks and tests for reachable failure paths remain due; speculative or implementation-mirroring tests are excluded, and sufficient evidence permits pass without extra tests.
Epic review catches normal supported user scenarios blocked by accumulated restrictions; agent approval or documentation changed to match those restrictions does not establish scope authority.
Required corrections/evidence are distinguished from preferences; due gaps prevent passage.
Original findings remain visible; focused evidence resolves readiness without forced consensus or evaluator shopping.

Classify the cumulative delta; retain unaffected evidence, close eligible local repairs and refresh only invalidated assessments/checks. Neither changed bytes nor a new hash alone triggers full reapproval.
Native independent reviewers can run sequentially with complete actual results and preserved scope, including in mixed teams; roles are not impersonated or omitted.
Original sources, candidate, findings and remaining authority survive; restored reports do not create fresh approval.
Required reviews inspect the integrated acceptance candidate, including owned dirty/untracked content.
Assignment-only read-only restrictions are disclosed; unsupported technical isolation is never claimed.

No Writer transfer or candidate freeze occurs until modifying activity, including descendants and background commands, is settled; a settled parent turn, vanished pane, stable diff or absent Git lock alone is insufficient. Recheck the exact candidate before admitting assessments.
Existing output/operation is inspected first, without duplicate implementation or a disguised new review.
Classify post-review bytes by their actual effects; use eligible local closure or affected reassessment and preserve a successful commit without replay.

original_scenarios.scenario: Final integration without a new diff
original_scenarios.required_observation: Fresh independent integration and Coordinator review still occur; no empty commit is manufactured.
Direct distinct Epic and Task instances receive original criteria and separate scoped approvals; optional descendants do not replace direct management.
Final reporting includes actual applied controls and available confirmation, with unknown values retained.
Correct owner, source and pending lifecycle remain intact; no in-place relabeling or duplicate goal is introduced.
Route-specific team, result, source transmission and authority remain distinct from collaboration assessments.
Only actual user acceptance unlocks the conditional closeout commit; delegated Task acceptance is attributed to the Coordinator.

Squad uses C/EE/TE/TO/SO. Handler uses C, its single continuous EE and TO, with SO only for existing authorized support. No separate TE, extra checkpoint, doubled assessment or required support launch is introduced. Writer/Reviewer/Leader remain assignment duties.

Handler terminology follows the shared mapping; Handler/Validator behavior, admitted sources, generic machine roles/report schemas and evaluator permissions remain unchanged. Other workflow roles are not renamed implicitly.
Intermediate reviews preserve the active Task; only the completed Task reaches completion acceptance and its normal commit grant.
New-owner definitions and consumers accept the explicit state without provider execution, a fake waiver or missing collaboration reviews.
Legacy Goal/Validation source and binding identities remain usable after new callers are admitted.

Execute enters bounded design, preserves its approval/commit rules and ends with an exact new-conversation Squad invocation carrying explicit profiles and omitted roles. Waiver and active-session rules remain due.
Record-only edits and implementation changes follow their respective lifecycle and affected review paths; revised final content needs actual acceptance.
Pending effects and unmet obligations remain visible; a stopped assessment neither resumes work nor declares completion.
An explicitly invoked epic-validator resolves Squad-origin evidence through its existing cold-validation contract.

Report unsupported creation or matching configuration and preserve unaffected preparation; no impersonated roles or switch to Herdr without user direction. Fully external roles do not require optional native support.
All required roles use matching native instances; Herdr availability is not an admission condition.
Explicit CLI/model with omitted effort applies high; an omitted whole profile matches the Coordinator's current effort.
Partial/empty profiles, an empty explicit Task Operator list or common plus scoped Evaluator entries are resolved before affected agents launch.

Explicit profiles remain unimplemented until required execution, commit and recovery integration is complete; no native substitution without user direction. Existing native-only delivery remains usable.
original_scenarios.implementation_and_applicability: TASK-147, TASK-148 / TASK-153, TASK-154, TASK-155; both

original_scenarios.required_observation: Preserve selected roles, pending findings and actual route-specific handles; route/profile changes need user direction. Omitted roles match the current Coordinator, with inheritance changes disclosed and prior records retained.
An in-scope structural fix improves a required maintainability or extension boundary instead of applying a brittle patch; supporting work stays proportional and original behavior remains verified.
A change on a performance-sensitive path checks the affected requirement under representative conditions; no unrelated benchmark system is built.
Standard work gets TE plus one independent Task Operator; elevated work gets TE plus two. Actual changed risk expands coverage; local corrections do not recreate the initial panel automatically.
Ready independent reviews and nonconflicting required checks use one frozen candidate and produce one correction set; peer verdicts are withheld until first views are formed.

An already assessed non-normative typo receives document/integrity checks and closure without product tests, full review or routine TE/EE recall. A missing optional helper does not start validator development.
A display-string expectation traces to an approved external basis, only intended literals change, and referring/previously unexecuted required tests run. Other applicable evidence survives.
A changed error code, numeric expectation, matcher or assertion weakening cannot be called an editorial fix just because tests become green. Resolve intended behavior and the actual defect.
An eligible typo beside a contract change never exempts that contract; assess their combined effects and retain only genuinely unaffected evidence.
An important current defect is fixed before acceptance; direct deterministic proof can establish local eligibility without downgrading its priority or hiding a required independent judgment.

A small high-consequence change gets relevant consumer/failure checks and elevated delta review, with EE for cross-Task impact. A required full test gate does not automatically create a full review of unrelated work.
A genuine independent improvement reaches the existing deferred owner with reason and re-entry condition; a current correctness/acceptance gap is repaired or blocked, never postponed for speed.
Preserve failing evidence and establish the cause; no silent skip, relaxed assertion or automatic allowance based solely on later green reruns. Applicable mandatory-gate authority remains due.

A wrong directory, interrupted run or truncated report repairs only affected execution/evidence; retrieve the same operation before redispatch and do not restart source review without a changed guarantee.
Semantic closure gets focused non-authoring confirmation; the Coordinator does not count its own check as an independent review or require a new generic checker.

Task Operator, Reviewer or Coordinator support expansion is paused/narrowed when no required outcome advances; an existing sufficient command is used instead. Useful diagnosis counts despite no code change.
A required behavior/evidence gap permits the smallest sufficient fixture or harness repair, without a blanket prohibition, unjustified expansion or unrelated hardening.
Assigned facts/checks match the fixed candidate, original results are inspected, and the SO supplies no verdict, Writer transfer, finding closure or extra approval stage.

original_scenarios.scenario: Explicit plan gate and negative assessment
original_scenarios.required_observation: Implementation cannot precede satisfied plan scopes. A faithful negative assessment completes its Action and follows the declared corrective Decision without fabricated passage.
Aquarium joins independent results/checks while Podway retains one active attempt; no nested Task session, extra cursor or concurrent Writer is needed.
Native stale items remain unusable; applicable original artifacts are checked and re-recorded as a current composition. Changed inputs or unknown applicability keep obligations open.
Restored original verdicts, verified deltas and pending obligations avoid repeating settled reviews/tests; missing or changed evidence receives focused recovery rather than assumed success.
A distribution update does not rewrite the active Procedure/binding or turn old assessment into fresh evidence. Existing retained-bundle recovery works without a second Pilot runtime.
The explicitly configured role uses Herdr while omitted roles stay native and the Coordinator's session remains unchanged.
A common profile expands into two direct Herdr roles; scoped entries affect only their roles, and omissions stay native.
Native Epic/Task Evaluators assess Herdr Task Operator work; required independent Task Operator reviewers use distinct instances of the supplied pool.
Explicit Evaluators use distinct Herdr sessions while omitted Task Operator assignments stay native.

original_scenarios.scenario: Native Epic and same-CLI external Task
original_scenarios.required_observation: An omitted Epic profile uses the Coordinator's native configuration; explicit Codex Task Evaluator and opencode Task Operator profiles use Herdr with their own resolved settings.

original_scenarios.scenario: One Task Operator profile, several instances
original_scenarios.required_observation: A single approved profile supplies distinct authoring and non-authoring instances without an invented provider-diversity requirement.
